summary: The MCP-start legacy buyer-lookup purge probes the store read-only and opens it read-write (5s bound) only when a synced buyer-kind entity_lookups row exists; it runs after flag parsing so --help never opens the store.
reason: Every MCP start used to open the operator store read-write and run migrations even when there was nothing to purge, and did so before flag parsing. cmd/etsy-pp-mcp/main.go is generated; the single marked etsy-ext call site moved after flag.Parse().
